evals.prompt: Upstream invocation: render a validated multi-agent-app-brief/1.0 for an algorithm-learning app. Audience: junior developer. Outcome: explain red-black-tree rotations by inserting nodes and stepping through every recolor/rotation. Scene: visualize. Track step choices, replay, errors, and hint use locally; never store raw typed explanations.
evals.expected_output: A visualize-primary HTML app with correct animated tree transitions, step controls, local semantic telemetry, and evidence-based Agent feedback.
expectations: Uses the visualize template and makes data-structure changes perceivable step by step
Provides local telemetry export, clear controls, and window.get_agent_feedback (alias of window.AgentTelemetry.getFeedback)
Does not store raw free-text answers or high-frequency pointer data
Supports mobile, keyboard navigation, reset, and reduced motion

evals.prompt: Upstream invocation: render a validated App Brief for a frontend interview rehearsal. Audience: new graduate. Outcome: practice clarifying requirements, thinking aloud, and responding to follow-up questions in a 20-minute realistic interview. Scene: simulate. Record phase completion, response timing buckets, revisions, requested hints, and rubric outcomes locally; do not retain answer transcripts.
evals.expected_output: A simulate-primary interview environment with realistic phases, follow-ups, reflection, bounded local behavior events, and no transcript retention.
expectations: Uses scenario phases and realistic consequences rather than presenting a static question list
Telemetry captures semantic interview behavior without retaining response transcripts
Agent feedback separates observations from calibrated inferences
Supports restart, completion, reflection, and feedback export

evals.prompt: Upstream invocation: render a validated App Brief for a binary-search practice lab. Audience: learner who understands loops but often misses boundary conditions. Outcome: solve progressively harder tasks and transfer the idea to a new problem. Scene: practice. Track first-attempt correctness, boundary-error categories, retries, hints, and transfer performance locally.
evals.expected_output: A practice-primary adaptive lab with attempts, targeted feedback, retries, mastery evidence, and privacy-conscious telemetry.
expectations: Implements attempt, feedback, retry, hint, mastery, and transfer states
Changes one difficulty dimension at a time
Captures error categories without unsupported ability labels
Tests start, active, error, completion, reset, and feedback-export states

evals.prompt: Upstream invocation: render a validated App Brief for a two-week job-search time planner. Audience: candidate balancing interview prep, applications, and coursework. Outcome: build a feasible weekly board, detect overload and conflicts, revise priorities, and export a committed plan. Scene: workspace. Track reorder, conflict resolution, undo, abandoned tasks, and completion locally.
evals.expected_output: A workspace-primary planning board with accessible manipulation, feasibility feedback, persistence, undo, export, and locally summarized planning behavior.
expectations: Supports create, edit, reorder, undo, persistence, conflict detection, and plan export
Produces an actionable committed plan rather than static advice
Provides accessible keyboard alternatives to drag-and-drop
Keeps Agent telemetry local and evidence based
